physiology:
The traditions seat this code in the skin, and in the fine hair that lifts off it. The body's outermost layer, the boundary that is also a listening organ. It is the part of you that meets the room before any other part does. Long before a thought forms about who has just walked in, the skin already knows.

The shadow has a bodily floor here. When a life is built on leaning, the skin loses its own intelligence. It stops registering for itself and starts registering for the other person, scanning their mood, ready to adjust. Touch becomes negotiation. Contact becomes a search for reassurance, and the wash of warmth that follows is mistaken for love. The body has been turned outward so long it has forgotten what the air on it feels like when no one else is in the room.

The climb out is also bodily. It begins quietly, with a person noticing their own skin again. The temperature of a doorway. The grain of a cup. The first true touch from another that lands without bracing. Sensitivity returns to its proper register, which is steady and curious, not hungry. The hairs lift to weather and to animals and to the grief in the next chair, and the body holds, because at last there is a self inside the skin to do the holding.
amino_acid:
Deeper than the skin, this code answers to Isoleucine. Isoleucine belongs to the small group the body cannot make for itself. It has to be taken in. Brought across the line of the mouth, broken down, and only then put to use. It is one of the building blocks the muscle leans on for endurance, and one of the chemistries that helps the body keep its own footing through long effort.

There is a teaching in that, and it is the quiet point of this card. The code about learning to stand on your own feet is built on an element that does not originate inside you. The chemistry of footing is itself received. Even the steadiness this card teaches has to be fed before it can hold. The lesson is not self-sufficiency in the cold sense. It is the slower thing, the thing the body has always known: that what carries you is partly given, and the work is to take it in cleanly and let it do its work.
